seed_scheme: pressure-{i} for passes and tail-run-{i} for runs; i=0..199; same indices across NE and CHI

setup.formation: first candidate formation for that offense and action, matching the existing sampler
setup.play_selection: createDemoScenario without candidateId; seeded weighted draw within the first formation
setup.fresh_inputs: team roster snapshot and both team playbook JSON files are reparsed from disk for each snap to prevent nested rating/physics mutation leaking across trials
setup.outcome_mode: free; no historical gain, end spot, tackler, receiver result, or catch-point anchors

pressure_method.pressured_definition: at least one defender within 2.0 m horizontally of the QB in a recorded live frame from snap to first throw, sack event, or whistle, whichever occurs first
pressure_method.distance_unit_basis: recorded x/y field coordinates in yards converted to meters with YD=0.9144; body height is excluded because the simulator uses planar player pursuit/contact geometry
pressure_method.min_distance: minimum defender-to-QB horizontal distance over the same live-frame window
pressure_method.time_to_pressure: first recorded frame at or within 2.0 m, seconds after snap; unpressured plays are right-censored and excluded from quantiles
pressure_method.shed_definition: a recorded shed event by a configured pass-rush slot (LEDGE/LDT/RDT/REDGE; add NB only when setupPass uses its heavy-set rule) strictly before the first 2 m frame; if no 2 m frame occurs, before the live-window endpoint

sack_inference.basis: engine/play.js free-pass World.onTouch path can emit sack on QB contact before throw; the existing committed 200-seed outcome sample also contains 5 CHI sacks, so the branch is observed reachable
sack_inference.confidence_method: exact zero-success binomial upper bound: 1 - (1 - confidence)^(1/n)

structural_sack_diagnostic.interpretation: sack counts are a geometry/blocking cap first, a rate second; a sampled proximity threshold is not proof of a pressure event
structural_sack_diagnostic.note: Interpret the geometry alongside the per-play records and engine collision/contact gates; do not infer calibrated sack rates from this sample.

run_tail_method.tackle_attempt_definition: a wrapped or broken_tackle event for the run carrier; these are emitted after the engine passes its close/alignment/closing-contact checks
run_tail_method.longest_uninterrupted_stretch: longest elapsed-time interval from handoff to a tackle-attempt event, between attempt events, or from the last attempt to terminal play time; defender proximity is sampled at the interval endpoint using the latest recorded frame at or before it
run_tail_method.nearby_defender_definition: any defensive player within 3.0 m horizontally of the runner at that sampled frame
run_tail_method.no_defender_ever_within_3m: no recorded live frame from handoff through terminal play time has a defender within 3.0 m
run_tail_method.final_wrap_time: last wrapped event time minus handoff event time; null when no wrap occurs

sampled_window_timing_diagnostic.interpretation: sampled minimum-distance frame and live-window duration; not time-to-pressure development
